description: Spacing, rhythm, typography hierarchy, alignment, proportion, and cross-section consistency polish across every page - plus fixing concrete vibe-coded artifacts - so the site reads as intentionally art-directed rather than template-generated. This is the 'make it feel professionally designed' pass. It is CSS-only (src/styles.css) plus, if strictly necessary, purely presentational class/markup tweaks in existing components (no copy, data, section, or functional changes). Builds on FEAT-002's image fitting. Adapt test's restrained/subtle motion + editorial spacing language to main's existing content and ScrollFocusStack system; do NOT blindly copy test.
steps: FIX DEFECT: src/styles.css ~line 2122 `.industry-grid li:not(:last-child)::after { content: ; }` has an empty (invalid) content value. Replace with a real inline separator glyph for the mobile inline-flow industries list, e.g. `content: "\00B7"; margin-inline: 0 0.3rem; color: var(--muted-foreground);` (a middot) so the flowed solutions read as a proper dot-separated list instead of running together. Verify the surrounding `.industry-grid ul { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap }` mobile rule still reads cleanly.

VERTICAL RHYTHM: audit `--section-gap` (clamp 2.5-4rem) and `--heading-gap` and the per-section padding (`.stack-chapter > .section-wrap` clamp 2.25-4rem, `.content-section` padding-block). Ensure consistent vertical spacing between comparable sections and that no section has conspicuously more empty space than its neighbors. Tighten `.section-action` margins and `.metrics-strip` bottom margin so the hero->metrics->first-chapter cadence is even. Do not introduce new global tokens; reuse the existing ones.

TYPOGRAPHY HIERARCHY: verify one consistent scale is used - page h1 (--display-xl / page-intro clamp), section h2 (--display-lg), card/subsection h3 (--display-md or the explicit 1.05rem used in pinned-services/showcase/industry). Make the pinned-services list h3 and the project-showcase-caption h3 and the industry h3 visually coherent (same family var(--font-display), comparable size/weight/line-height). Ensure kicker/eyebrow treatment (--text-micro, uppercase, 0.13em tracking, --raspberry-ink) is identical everywhere it appears (.eyebrow, .section-kicker). Fix any heading that is too large relative to its body copy or dwarfs its section.

ALIGNMENT & PROPORTION: verify grid column ratios are intentional and consistent between analogous layouts (hero 0.83/1.17, about-split 0.9/1.1, contact-layout 0.85/1.15, faq-section 0.75/1.25, founder-story 0.7fr/1.3fr). Align these toward a coherent asymmetry rather than five slightly different ratios where they play the same role. Ensure card paddings are consistent across .project-card / .service-card / .values-grid article / .industry-grid article / .benefit-row article / .contact-options a so cards feel like one system.

BUTTON SIZING & ALIGNMENT: verify the editorial/hero button and .text-link have consistent min-height and vertical alignment in .hero-actions and every .section-action; ensure the <=600px two-column hero-actions grid does not squash label text awkwardly (font-size 0.72rem currently) - keep tap targets >=44px.

PROJECTS EDITORIAL GRID RHYTHM (src/components/projects-showcase-grid.tsx SPANS + src/styles.css .project-showcase-grid): main renders all 16 projects but SPANS has only 8 entries and cycles every 8 tiles, so the large-tile rhythm repeats identically in the two halves. Review whether the 220px auto-row + repeat(4) with two span-2 tiles per 8 reads as balanced editorial rather than mechanically repeating; if it looks repetitive, extend/vary the SPANS array (presentational only - keep it deriving from `i % SPANS.length` or lengthen to cover 16) so the wall of work feels composed. Keep every project (do not slice/limit on /projects). Keep the parallax + caption.

DENSITY/COMPACTNESS: the user asked for compact, well-composed. Where sections feel loose (large min-heights on sticky chapters, oversized gaps), tighten conservatively without breaking the ScrollFocusStack sticky math (respect `--header-h`, the .motion-stage min-heights, and the .stack-services 190svh travel budget comment). Do not reduce travel budgets that motion depends on.

CROSS-SECTION CONSISTENCY: ensure the colored wash chapters (stack-services lavender, stack-industries sky, stack-story butter, stack-process mint, stack-faq lavender, dark-band ink) use a consistent tint intensity and that text contrast holds on each (dark-band already overrides kicker/body colors). Verify borders/radii/shadows on the sticky .stack-chapter boxes are consistent between home and the interior .motion-chapter boxes on services/about.

Keep all motion rAF-gated + reduced-motion-safe and no-JS-safe; do not alter the JS motion logic in this feature except presentational SPANS array length in projects-showcase-grid.tsx if needed for rhythm.
acceptance_criteria: The invalid `content: ;` rule is replaced with a valid separator; grep `grep -nE "content:\s*;" src/styles.css` returns nothing.
Heading sizes follow one consistent scale (h1 display-xl, h2 display-lg, h3 display-md/1.05rem) and kicker/eyebrow styling is identical everywhere.
Analogous two-column layouts use coherent, intentional column ratios and consistent card padding across the card families.
The /projects editorial grid reads as a balanced asymmetric wall for all 16 projects (SPANS covers or cleanly cycles 16 without an obviously mechanical repeat).
All 16 projects, 4 services, 8 technologies, 19 industries, 4 metrics, 4 values, 4 process steps, and 5 FAQs remain rendered; no copy/data/section removed; src/lib/site-data.ts unchanged.
Motion remains rAF-gated and reduced-motion-safe; ScrollFocusStack sticky/travel math (header-h offsets, .motion-stage min-heights, .stack-services 190svh) is not broken.
verification: Deferred to CI: `unset NODE_OPTIONS && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build` must all pass (test suite guards content counts).
Run `git diff -- src/lib/site-data.ts` and confirm it is EMPTY (no content changes).
Run `grep -nE "content:\s*;" src/styles.css` and confirm no matches.
Review src/styles.css brace balance and that no design token in :root was redefined.
findings: CSS-only pass (src/styles.css) plus the single allowed SPANS constant in projects-showcase-grid.tsx. Built on top of FEAT-002 (image fitting left intact). DEFECT #1 already fixed by FEAT-002 (content:"\00B7" middot separator on .industry-grid li::after) - verified `grep -nE 'content:\s*;'` returns nothing; left as-is. Harmonized: (1) COLUMN RATIOS collapsed to two intentional families - balanced-asymmetry minmax(0,0.85fr)/minmax(0,1.15fr) for .home-hero (was 0.83/1.17), .about-split (was 0.9/1.1), .contact-layout (was 0.85/1.15, added minmax); heading-left minmax(0,0.8fr)/minmax(0,1.2fr) for .faq-section (was 0.75/1.25) and .founder-story (was 0.7/1.3, kept the 15rem min on the portrait column). (2) CARD PADDING unified to 1.25rem across .service-card (was 1.15/1.25/1.35), .contact-options>a (was 1.2rem) to match .values-grid article / .benefit-row article (already 1.25rem); .industry-grid article kept 1.1rem in both base and the >=901px 4-up variant (was 1.05rem there) as an intentionally dense bordered grid; .service-card::after index badge realigned to right 1.25rem/top 1.1rem. (3) TYPOGRAPHY: removed .page-intro h1 font-size override (was clamp(2.4rem,4vw,4rem)) so every page title inherits --display-xl like the hero; .project-showcase-caption h3 line-height 1.25->1.2 so all three 1.05rem/1.2 display-font sub-card h3s (pinned-services list, showcase caption, industry) match; kicker/eyebrow (.eyebrow/.section-kicker) already identical, left as-is. (4) CROSS-SECTION TINT normalized wash chapters to a ~55-58% band: .stack-services 62->55, .stack-story (butter) 42->55, .stack-process (mint) 66->58, .stack-faq 42->55 (.stack-industries already 55); .wash-mint 62->58 to match .stack-process; .wash-lavender already 55; .dark-band unchanged (var(--ink)). Interior /services and /about-us chapters use full-bleed wash bands (wash-lavender/dark-band) vs home's rounded .stack-chapter cards - a deliberate treatment difference, so only the wash colors were aligned, not the box framing. (5) RHYTHM: .section-action margin-top 1.9rem -> clamp(1.5rem,2.5vw,2rem) to scale with page rhythm. (6) SPANS extended from 8 to 16 entries with large 2x2 tiles at irregular indices 0,6,9,14 (was 0,5 cycling every 8, which mirrored the two halves of the 16-project wall); still presentational and consumed via i % SPANS.length, every project still rendered (no slice/limit on /projects). NOT TOUCHED (protected): all --header-h sticky top offsets, .motion-stage min-heights, the .stack-services 190svh travel budget, JS motion/lerp logic, reduced-motion and <=900px gates. Verification deferred to CI (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY: npm registry unreachable, cannot run typecheck/lint/test/build locally). In-sandbox correctness checks passed: braces balanced 398/398, no bare `content:;`, no :root design token redefined, no line >100 cols (prettier printWidth) in styles.css or the tsx, git diff of src/lib/site-data.ts and src/assets/images.ts both EMPTY.
